dct_description_sm: At top of map: No. 3; Culp's Hill.

At top of map: No. 3; Culp's Hill. Map title, legend, and a brief account of the "Work completed on United States property on this square by the Gettysburg National Park Commission," signed by E. B. Cope, Engineer, is attached to the map in the lower left corner. Detailed map of Culp's Hill, with manuscript annotations and hand coloring, showing the extent of U.S. property, telford roads, stone walls, rebuilt stone walls, mounted guns, monuments and markers, lines of earth works, and lunettes for artillery. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:2400. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 351.4 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
